description: Confirmatory experiment protocol for the ExtStats Advisor paper. This file freezes required evidence and comparison semantics, but does not freeze final source revisions or build identities.

postgresql_identity_source.rule: Use the built role identity as the source of exact PostgreSQL source/version/configuration/build provenance; do not infer final paper pins from a floating version string.

freeze_gate.rule: Do not silently substitute the current manuscript commit or a floating PostgreSQL version for any unresolved identity.

seed_policy.semantic_rule: The seed identifier and the PostgreSQL floating-point setseed argument are distinct protocol fields. Integer-division spelling is forbidden.

datasets.truth_source: manifest-bound; use authoritative-external-exact or production-exact-execution only when the selected contract validates it
manifest-bound; use authoritative-external-exact or production-exact-execution only when the selected contract validates it
manifest-bound; use authoritative-external-exact or production-exact-execution only when the selected contract validates it

ground_truth_input.role: Evaluate planner estimates and define utility; never construct native statistics and never alter the PostgreSQL estimator.

source_kinds.collection: Exact counts in a read-only repeatable-read source view.
source_kinds.constraints: Only the supported sealed postgresql-simple-selection-v2 workload contract; exact collection can be expensive.

source_kinds.collection: Import and validate externally produced exact labels with provenance and snapshot/workload binding.
source_kinds.constraints: The advisor must not claim to have executed externally supplied labels.

metrics_and_objectives.optimization_objective: sum(weight_q * Q_q) / sum(weight_q) over positive-weight workload queries
metrics_and_objectives.uniform_weight_rule: If a confirmatory workload has weight one for every query, arithmetic mean and the optimization objective coincide numerically but remain distinct contracts.

required_baseline_configurations.role: RQ1 stock baseline and deployment target

required_baseline_configurations.dataset_variation_rule: Preserve any audited dataset-specific baseline difference and record it in the manifest. Current four paper-baseline manifests record target 10000; Census13 records the target at baseline level.

fixed_k_quality.k_policy: Pre-register k independently of the final advisor recommendation.
fixed_k_quality.ground_truth_policy: Heuristic selection cannot use GroundTruthSet; utility-based methods use the same bound GroundTruthSet after selection as declared by RQ4.
fixed_k_quality.budget_policy: Declare and report a maximum planner-evaluation budget and actual evaluations for every method.

fixed_evaluation_budget.budget_policy: Pre-register common planner-evaluation and wall-clock caps.
fixed_evaluation_budget.information_policy: Do not convert unused budget into extra information for another method; infeasible variants are censored.

experiments.random_seed_policy: Use dataset adapter and baseline manifest seeds; record experiment seed identifier and exact PostgreSQL setseed SQL.
completion_criteria: all source identities resolved
matched per-dataset manifests validated
raw and derived artifacts content-addressed

protocol: P1 add-only Recommendation plus final ANALYZE
P2 research-only advisor-object removal without ANALYZE followed by rollback
experiments.random_seed_policy: Reuse the frozen dataset/sample protocol and record all seeds in the RunManifest.
completion_criteria: P1/P2 ordinary-statistics contract verified
advisor-managed object identity verified
rollback evidence present

experiments.truth_contract: One bound GroundTruthSet contract for the paired sample/full comparison.
experiments.random_seed_policy: Freeze sample seed, workload order, and all search seeds in the manifest.
completion_criteria: both utilities use the declared loss/weight contracts
no RQ3 mechanism claim is inferred from this relationship

experiments.comparison: Physical native statistics versus catalogless hypothetical overlay on the same patched PostgreSQL binary.
experiments.main_factor: physical catalog realization versus hypothetical overlay realization
controls: identical payload bytes where technically possible
derived_metrics: q-error correlation as secondary diagnostic only
experiments.truth_contract: GroundTruthSet is not required to establish mechanism fidelity; if utility is reported, bind it separately and do not make it the primary fidelity metric.
experiments.random_seed_policy: Record all data/sample/statistics seeds; no unrecorded randomization in paired configurations.

artifact_contract.primary_metric: direct exact root Plan Rows agreement
artifact_contract.status_semantics: A runner result is artifact-created with fidelity_gate pass/fail. Paper status becomes ready-to-run only after a live exact gate; no artifact is complete by itself.

experiments.implementation_status: The three-configuration synthetic runner and rq3-fidelity-v1 cross-field validator are implemented and unit-validated. A live run against the pinned patched PostgreSQL build is still required before promotion to ready-to-run; no benchmark result is complete.
completion_criteria: same patched binary verified for both primary arms
physical and overlay states independently verified
no binary/build substitution used to claim primary fidelity

experiments.comparison: Patched PostgreSQL physical statistics versus stock PostgreSQL physical statistics with hypothetical overlay inactive.
experiments.role: Secondary ordinary physical-statistics sanity check; never the primary hypothetical-fidelity result.
experiments.implementation_blocker: No current paired sanity artifact proves patched physical semantics equal stock physical semantics with the overlay inactive.
completion_criteria: overlay inactive verified
stock and patched physical setup independently verified
result labeled secondary sanity only

experiments.ground_truth_policy: Only utility-based methods use GroundTruthSet during selection; every selected result is evaluated against the same bound truth.
experiments.random_seed_policy: Pre-register replicate seeds; record them and break non-random ties by candidate ID after declared score/static precedence.
completion_criteria: k is pre-registered independently of final advisor recommendation
planner evaluation counts are reported for all methods

experiments.random_seed_policy: Pre-register replicate seeds and record actual planner evaluations and wall time.
completion_criteria: no method receives a silently larger budget
infeasible exhaustive variants are labeled censored

experiments.truth_cost_rule: Report external import/validation separately from production exact count collection; neither is a proxy for the other.
experiments.random_seed_policy: Use the corresponding frozen run seed policy and record environment/measurement repetitions.
completion_criteria: all measured stages have provenance
no zero-online-overhead claim is substituted for measured costs

execution_priorities.name: protocol/source freeze and RQ3 mechanism-fidelity harness
RQ1 matched baselines and RQ4 inexpensive heuristic baselines
RQ2 confirmatory transfer and sample/full utility analysis
RQ5 cost accounting and sensitivity analyses

global_completion_criteria: All required source identities are resolved in the paper-experiment manifest.
The research tree is clean before every canonical run.
Each raw artifact is versioned or content-addressed and bound to a RunManifest.
Each derived artifact records source artifact digests and system identities.
Expected paper figures/tables are reproducible from declared derived artifacts.
Pilot/preliminary evidence is never silently relabeled complete.
Superseded results remain referenced with status superseded rather than overwritten.
